purpose: Post-rowtile draft_p_min re-tune (p_min was set pre-rowtile). Tests whether the ~13% cheaper verify shifts the optimal p_min lower (more drafts).
finding: p_min=0.5 remains optimal post-rowtile. Lower p_min raises acc/out marginally but proposes low-confidence drafts -> draft_acc collapses (0.72->0.48) -> wasted verify rows dominate -> net slower. Rowtile did not shift the optimum. Acceptance side fully swept (ja-cap, p_min 0/0.3/0.5, budgets 1-5); all confirm the default 1.1134x.
